facts.text: Under Rivier's Employment Promise Program, students not employed full-time within nine months of graduating receive either up to 12 months of student loan payments or six free graduate courses.

sources.title: Employment Promise Program | Rivier University
sources.quote: Graduates unemployed nine months after graduation may choose either: Federal Loan Repayment. Rivier University will make the graduate's monthly federal subsidized student loan payment for up to 12 months OR Tuition-free Graduate Study.
